topic: remove pen ink marks from a leather bag
core_question: How do I get pen ink off a leather handbag?
answer_summary: Dip a cotton swab in rubbing (isopropyl) alcohol and gently dab — not rub — at the ink mark until it lifts, testing on a hidden spot first, then wipe clean and condition the leather.
persona: friendly but persistent; using casual slang
